messages:
Maya (PM): Quick thread: need a final call on the observability runway. Customers want dashboards + trace linking + per-tenant cost. Ops says we need a defensible default. Proposing narrow MVP with a clear expansion ladder.
Arjun (Eng): Suggestion: minimal API + opt-in escalations. Ship 2 dashboard templates: "Overview" and "Cost by Route". Add a lightweight trace hook that appends tenant_id and route. Sampling ladder: default 0.25% -> can escalate to 2% for short windows.
Priya (SRE): Ops constraints: network + storage. 0.25% is safer for general availability. Any escalation must be limited by tokens and a manual approval flow. Also require an auto-safety to cut sampling if trace egress > 60% quota.
Ben (Data): For cost, Phase 1 = low-fidelity estimates from aggregates (tokens, latency_ms, model_unit_price). We'll return a confidence score. Full per-span attribution (billing-grade) is Phase 2 and needs schema changes + reconciliation. We can provide CSV export for QBRs in Phase 1.
Zoe (Design): UX: cards for Estimated Spend, Top Routes, and Attribution Confidence. For traces: sampled trace viewer with short summary (tenant, route, sample_reason). Add microcopy explaining 'estimated' vs 'billed'.
Clara (Research): Quick note: error fingerprinting will help prioritize top error signatures. We can run a lightweight clustering job to surface top-5 fingerprints for the dashboard. Low cost and high signal.
Maya (PM): Proposed launch acceptance (draft):
- Dashboards: 2 templates render with synthetic + pilot data
- Tracing: tenant_id + route in spans; default sample_rate 0.25%; sampled trace viewer behind flag
- Cost: estimated per-tenant monthly & per-route + CSV export + confidence pill
- Errors: top-5 error fingerprints surfaced with up to N sampled traces each
- Safety: per-tenant daily cap (500 traces), escalation tokens for support, auto-throttle at 60% quota
(need :thumbsup: from Eng/SRE/Data/Design/Research)
Arjun (Eng): :thumbsup: from Eng. Implementation caveats: need to thread tenant_id into KV layer and carry it through sampler. Trace TTL 7 days. I'll own PR for the hook + UI toggle.
Priya (SRE): :thumbsup: from SRE if default is 0.25% and caps & auto-safety exist. Add alert to #eng-oncall when any tenant > 50% of daily cap. Require manual approval for escalations beyond 2% for >24h.
Ben (Data): :thumbsup: from Data. I'll deliver the aggregate pipeline and a mapping doc for model_unit_price. Expect Phase 1 dataset + CSV endpoint in 4 business days.
Zoe (Design): :thumbsup: from Design. I'll post mocks for the cards and the confidence pill by EOD tomorrow. Also propose a "cost fidelity" toggle in the UI that explains the difference.
Clara (Research): :thumbsup: from Research. I'll surface top-5 fingerprints and a small sampling job to collect traces for those signatures.
Maya (PM): Action items & owners:
- Arjun: tenant tagging PR + sampling ladder UI (owner) — due in 5 days
- Priya: throttle + alert rules + approval workflow (owner) — due in 6 days
- Ben: aggregated cost pipeline + CSV export + mapping doc (owner) — due in 4 days
- Zoe: mocks + microcopy + cost fidelity toggle (owner) — due EOD tomorrow
- Clara: fingerprinting job + sample traces (owner) — due in 3 days
- Maya: pilot rollout plan & customer comms (owner) — due next Wednesday
Arjun (Eng): I'll open branch feature/obs-runway and link CI; will include a short retention policy for sampled traces (7d).
deploy-bot: build/ci-pipeline #984 passed for branch feature/obs-runway (1822223500)
Maya (PM): Thanks team. Decision: ship conservative MVP (0.25% default, caps, estimated cost) behind feature flag to pilot customers. We'll validate telemetry & throttles during pilot and then open the runway for Phase 2. If blockers appear, drop them here and escalate to #eng-oncall.
